settings.title: SAT — electronic invoicing
settings.description: The clinic as issuer of CFDIs, and its digital seal certificate (CSD).
settings.taxRegimeHint: The one on the clinic's tax status certificate.
settings.postalCodeHint: The postal code of the address invoices are issued from.
settings.productCodeHint: The code from the SAT's c_ClaveProdServ catalogue on every line. Check it with your accountant.
settings.unitCodeHint: From the c_ClaveUnidad catalogue. E48 is “service unit”.
settings.stampDelayHint: Leaves time to record the payment: paid when stamped, the CFDI is PUE; otherwise PPD. The SAT allows 24 hours.

environment.label: Environment
environment.sandboxHint: Stamped against the PAC's test service; nothing reaches the SAT.
environment.productionHint: CFDIs are stamped for real and registered with the SAT.

status.ready: The clinic can invoice through the SAT
status.notReady: The clinic cannot invoice through the SAT yet
status.sandbox: Test environment: CFDIs do not reach the SAT.
status.production: Production environment: CFDIs are registered with the SAT.

issuer.title: Issuer
issuer.hint: These are the clinic's, as they appear on its tax status certificate.

facturama.title: Facturama account
facturama.intro: Facturama is the PAC that seals and stamps CFDIs. Each clinic uses its own account, one for test and one for production.
facturama.passwordKept: One is stored. Leave it empty to keep it.
facturama.encryptionNote: The password is stored encrypted and never shown.

certificate.title: Digital seal certificate (CSD)
certificate.none: There is no CSD yet. Without it the clinic cannot invoice.
certificate.passwordHint: The one set when the CSD was generated at the SAT, not the e.firma's.
certificate.uploadFailed: The CSD could not be saved
certificate.encryptionNote: The private key and its password are stored encrypted and never shown. On saving, the CSD is registered with Facturama, which seals CFDIs with it.
certificate.registerFailed: The CSD could not be registered with Facturama

receiver.title: Tax details for the SAT
receiver.noRfc: The patient has no billing RFC. Add it to their billing details (Info tab) to invoice them by name.
receiver.public: The billing RFC is the general public's (XAXX010101000): no tax details needed.
receiver.taxZipCodeHint: The one on their tax status certificate.
receiver.missing: The tax details of {rfc} are missing
receiver.missingHint: Without tax regime, fiscal postal code and CFDI use no invoice can be issued to them. They are kept by RFC: they serve all their invoices.
